shorts.outro: It swam straight over Doug's cage and ignored him. Two stops later, a sperm whale with a three-meter skull did not. Linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID THE GIANT SPERM WHALE DO?

shorts.outro: Then Doug got into a cage next to a shark, right in front of them, holding a toothbrush. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID DOUG DO WITH THE TOOTHBRUSH?

shorts.hook: HMS Challenger hauled up megalodon teeth from the Pacific.
shorts.outro: So it is not down there. Doug went to see the last megalodon instead, three point six million years ago. It is linked below.
shorts.end_card: HOW DID THE LAST MEGALODON VANISH?
